headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so AI agents can shop
dek: Dots agents shop with a card, for US Pro subscribers only, per CNBC.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: The wallet
body: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting Dots agents buy on the user's behalf, per CNBC and the Verge.
It starts limited to US Pro subscribers aged 18 or older (CNBC).

points.t: Each purchase needs a security check.
The agent never sees the real card number.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Merchants and cost
body: OpenAI takes no commission in this early phase, per CNBC.
Amazon already blocks shopping agents, and United Airlines will block them (CNBC).

stat.cap: in this early phase, says CNBC

items.t: OpenAI says agent commerce is early (CNBC).
Meta also competes in shopping agents (Verge).

caption.hook: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, a wallet for Dots agents to shop.
body: Per CNBC and the Verge, the feature starts limited to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the United States. The agent finds the product but only completes the purchase after a security check on every transaction, which can be biometric, per the Verge.

The agent never sees the real card number, only a payment token, per CNBC. OpenAI takes no commission in this early phase. CNBC notes Amazon already blocks shopping agents and United Airlines will block bookings by agents. The company says agent commerce is still at an early stage.
